title: Fourier norm of a product
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and all real-valued functions $f$ and $g$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, the Fourier one-norm of their pointwise product is at most the product of their Fourier one-norms.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ are real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
